coverage: Whole image and each half emitted and read once. notes.text: The typed heading reads Massy le 23.6.1971. The salutation addresses Verdier with a clipped initial C. The body explicitly says lettre du 23 Mai; 23 is read from the visible numeral, not replaced by an editorial comparison. No signature is visible. Lower-left 12 is archival numbering.
notes.basis: Observation: heading, salutation, first body line, closing and half b. H's note about another page is outside this reading and was not checked.

notes.text: The letter regrets not receiving the malheureux exer 4.10.6 and refers to sending fascicule 1 de SGA 4 to the printer. The clipped word after que and conditional-looking continuation after cela a cannot be completed from the ink. These publication references are not mathematical propositions.
notes.basis: Observation: body lines 1–4; crops 02, 05 and 07. No reconstruction from context.

notes.text: The typist is said to termine mainte… and then to depart on holiday; Springer rend la machine … avait en location, faute d'autres manuscrits. The final sentence says publication is postponed sine …ie. The ends of mainte… and the initial of …ie remain clipped, and the deleted tail after elle is preserved.
notes.basis: Observation: body lines 4–8 and crops 08–13; interpretation of the readable prose, with physical losses kept explicit.

notes.text: The initial e of envoyé bears visible extra accent ink; circumflex and grave remain candidates. The final fascimle/fascicule cluster is too compact and dark to decide m versus overlapping cu. Heavy type is not taken as proof of a distinct prior letter or of strike order.
notes.basis: Observation: crops 04, 09 and 12. No contextual spelling repair.

notes.text: All source capitals were inspected individually: Massy, clipped Cher, Verdier, Merci, Mai, C'est, clipped SGA, La, Springer, clipped Cela, Bien. The intact letters have ordinary typewriter contours, without an independently distinguishable doubled mathematical alphabet. H's supplied initials are recorded as differences of uncertainty/restoration status, not automatically as erroneous spellings.
notes.basis: Observation: half a; relevant edge crops 01, 07 and 11. H editorial notes are not copied as source text.

notes.text: No mathematical proof checking, independent re-proof, computation or formal certification was performed. This run is a diplomatic source reading only.
